title: XMRegistry Destination
description: Signed registry destination definition published by XMRegistry and installable into XMIntake workspace destinations.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation of this destination file.

id.description: Stable destination identifier (slug). Used for display, apiSlug generation, and config keys.

source.description: Canonical registry URL for this destination. Must not change over the destination lifetime.

title.description: Human-readable destination title shown in XMIntake.

description.description: Short description of the destination purpose and publisher context.

color.description: Accent color for destination UI (publisher default; may be overridden locally after install).

destinationType.description: Destination routing type. GOOGLE_SHEET maps to workspace kind sheet; CUSTOM_API maps to workspace kind api.

registryStatus.description: Registry lifecycle status at publish time. Only ACTIVE destinations may be installed.

createdAt.description: When this destination definition was first created. Must equal certificate.createdAt.

issuedAt.description: When the current certificate was issued. Must equal certificate.issuedAt.

expiresAt.description: When the current certificate expires. Must equal certificate.expiresAt.

replacementUrl.description: Optional URL of the replacement destination when registryStatus is DEPRECATED.

spreadsheetId.description: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID. Required when destinationType is GOOGLE_SHEET.

gid.description: Google Sheets tab gid. Required when destinationType is GOOGLE_SHEET.

endpointUrl.description: HTTPS POST endpoint URL. Required when destinationType is CUSTOM_API.

schemaUrl.description: URL of the XMIntake intake schema JSON. Required when destinationType is CUSTOM_API.

apiAuth.description: Authentication method for CUSTOM_API uploads. API_KEY prompts for a local key; GOOGLE_ID_TOKEN uses the app default OAuth Web client; NONE sends no auth headers.

certificate.description: XMRegistry-signed certificate covering this destination definition (except certificate.signature).

color.description: Six-digit hex color with leading hash.

quotaPolicy.description: Upload quota policy certified by XMRegistry. SPONSORED and EXEMPT bypass plan quotas when the certificate signature is valid.

publisher.description: Organization or individual responsible for the destination endpoint and support.

certificate.description: Signed certificate metadata. The signature covers the entire destination document except certificate.signature.

createdAt.description: Certificate creation timestamp. Must equal top-level createdAt.

issuedAt.description: Certificate issue timestamp. Must equal top-level issuedAt.

expiresAt.description: Certificate expiration timestamp. Must equal top-level expiresAt.

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over the canonical destination JSON (UTF-8), excluding this field.
